description:
Look up a company by NIF/CIF. Use it for a tax ID; for names,
search_companies. On a hit, call company_history with company_slug.

Returns {found, company_slug, current_name, website, lei, nif_caveat, ...}; use
current_name. lei: GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier matched by NIF; null means
no match yet. website: newest BORME website act; null if none or
removed.

BORME has no dedicated tax-ID field: more than 580,000 NIF mappings from
public sources and the text of BORME notices cover a minority of companies.
reason nif_unmapped: not matched yet, not proof of absence.
reason nif_revoked: AEAT records a revocation; relay tell_the_user.
On a company match, relay nif_status.note if present.
invalid_input true: not a NIF/CIF.
reason nif_check_character_failed: relay tell_the_user and did_you_mean.
reason not_registry_entity: explain entity_type.
ambiguous true: ask which one. nif_caveat: say the link is not settled.

Read-only. Basic plan+. API key: X-API-Key
(https://bormeapi.com/account).

nif.description: Spanish NIF/CIF, normally 9 characters, e.g. B12345674. Spaces, hyphens, dots and the ES VAT prefix (ESB12345674) are accepted; other country prefixes are not.
nif.title: Nif

name: company_by_nif
title: Find a company by NIF
